idea-plugin.name: Phantom Profiler
idea-plugin.description: CPU and allocation profiling for Java and Kotlin with Java Flight Recorder, which ships with the JDK: a Profile action next to Run and Debug that opens the recording when the program ends, a Profiler tool window that starts and stops recording in any running JVM, and a viewer for .jfr files with a flame graph, call tree, hot methods, allocations by class and GC summary. Double-click a frame to open its source. Nothing runs until you profile. Profile also works on Gradle run configurations: tests run by Gradle and applications delegated to Gradle get one recording per forked JVM.
